#DATA IMPORT

#PART ONE:    DESCRIPTIVE STATISTICS

1.    First 6 observations

```{r}
head(heart)
```

```{r}
str(heart)
```


3.    Summary of all the data

```{r}
summary(heart)
```


4.    Histogram rep of age

```{r}
hist(heart$sex)
```

```{r}
sd(heart$sex)
```

#PART TWO:    NORMALITY TEST

```{r}
shapiro.test(heart$chol)
```

```{r}
shapiro.test(heart$sex)
```

```{r}
boxplot(heart)
```


#PART THREE:    HYPOTHESIS TEST (NON-PARAMETRIC)

1.    Hypothesis test between (sex) and (thalach)

```{r}
wilcox.test(heart$sex, heart$thalach, paired=TRUE) 
```
2.    Hypothesis test between (sex) and (chol)

```{r}
wilcox.test(heart$sex, heart$chol, paired=TRUE)
```

3.    Hypothesis test between (sex) and (trestbps)

```{r}
wilcox.test(heart$sex, heart$trestbps, paired=TRUE)
```


#PART FOUR:   ANOVA (NON PARAMETRIC)

ANOVA test between group of (sex) and (thalach)

```{r}
kruskal.test(thalach ~ sex,
  data = heart
)
```

```{r}
anova(lm(heart$thalach ~ heart$sex))
```


```{r}
library(ggstatsplot)

ggbetweenstats(
  data = heart,
  x = sex,
  y = thalach,
  type = "nonparametric", # ANOVA or Kruskal-Wallis
  plot.type = "box",
  pairwise.comparisons = TRUE,
  pairwise.display = "significant",
  centrality.plotting = FALSE,
  bf.message = FALSE
)
```


#PART FIVE:   CHI- SQUARE OF INDEPENDENCE

Chi-square test between (sex) and (chol)

```{r}
test <- chisq.test(table(heart$sex, heart$chol))
test
```

#PART SIX:    CORRELATION (NON-PARAMETRIC TEST)

1.    correlation test between (age) and (thalach)

```{r}
cor(heart$age, heart$thalach)
```
```{r}
plot(heart$age, heart$thalach)
```


2.    correlation test between (age) and (tresbps)

```{r}
cor(heart$age, heart$trestbps)
```


```{r}
plot(heart$age, heart$trestbps)
```


3.    correlation test between (age) and (chol)

```{r}
cor(heart$age, heart$chol)
```

```{r}
plot(heart$age, heart$chol)
```


4.    correlation test between all variables

```{r}
cor(heart)
plot(heart)
```



#PART SEVEN:    LINEAR REGRESSION


1.    Linear regression between (age) and (chol)

```{r}
plot(heart$chol, heart$age)
model<-lm(heart$age~heart$chol)
abline(model, col="red", lwd =2)
summary(model)
cor.test(heart$chol, heart$age)
```

2.    Linear regression between (age) and (trestbps)

```{r}
plot(heart$age, heart$trestbps)
model<-lm(heart$trestbps~heart$age)
abline(model, col="red", lwd =2)
summary(model)
cor.test(heart$age, heart$trestbps)
```
